title: upgradeToAndCall is open to any account
rootCause: WellUpgradeable.upgradeToAndCall relies on a check of the new implementation alone, with nothing about who is asking, so any account can repoint a proxy and have the new code run a call of its choosing at once.

poc.observable: test_upgrade_and_call_is_not_open_to_a_stranger fails with "the proxy still points where the owner set it: 0xe884a82288341db01fec531659b3338Cbe4a3A55 != 0x104fBc016F4bb334D775a19E8A6510109AC63E00"
